description: The bar chart compares the accuracy of two text annotation tools, TEXTBLOB and VADER, in sentiment analysis across two categories of tweets: those containing emojis and all tweets. The vertical axis represents accuracy, ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, while the horizontal axis lists the two categories of tweets. For tweets containing emojis, TEXTBLOB has an accuracy of approximately 0.4, and VADER has an accuracy of about 0.6. In the category of all tweets, TEXTBLOB's accuracy is roughly 0.4, and VADER's accuracy is around 0.7. The bars are grouped by category, with each tool's accuracy represented by a separate bar within each group. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
